description: Pull embedded images out of a PDF and write each as a PNG. Unsupported pixel layouts (e.g. CMYK, palettized) are skipped and reported.

basename.description: Stem for output filenames. Default = source name. Final form: '<stem>-p001-img01.png'.

outputDir.description: Directory to write extracted images into.

pages.description: 1-based page range. Omit for all pages. Format: "1-5" or "1,3,5-7".

path.description: Absolute path to the source PDF.

name: extract_images
title: Extract embedded images
